caption: The drawing features five small rectangular objects arranged in a loose vertical grouping near the center of a beige background. The uppermost object is a metallic case shown open, rendered in color with a primarily silver exterior and a brownish interior; the inner surface of the case is decorated with green ornamental patterns. Below and around this, four other rectangular objects are drawn only in fine pencil lines, lacking color. These objects appear similar in shape and size to the open case, with visible decorative details on their surfaces, suggesting possible engravings or embossed designs. One of these is also shown as a box with a lid slightly ajar, depicted at an angle. The rest are rendered as closed rectangular forms with ornate outer patterns. The majority of the composition is left as blank space, with the drawn objects comprising only a small portion of the overall page.
title: Box
